responsibility: Supports semantic resolution of DATA statements and the construction of corresponding initializers. It computes array-element offsets for DATA assignments, formalizes and normalizes constructor ordering, updates section indices while traversing implied-DO and array-section assignments, and builds character and structure initializers consistent with Fortran assignment rules.
same_name_distinction: Implements the actual DATA-statement initializer machinery: computing section and element offsets, advancing implied-DO/section indices, creating character/structure initializers, and normalizing constructor order. Unlike gcc/fortran/data.h, it contains the DATA semantics and initializer-building logic, not just helper declarations.
